mapper.insert: insert into ontology_analysis_log (task_id, run_token, log_level, log_category, stage, message, detail_json, created_at) values (#{taskId}, #{runToken}, #{logLevel}, #{logCategory}, #{stage}, #{message}, #{detailJson}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select log_id, task_id, run_token, log_level, log_category, stage, message, detail_json, created_at from ontology_analysis_log where task_id = #{taskId} and run_token = #{runToken} order by log_id limit 500
